outcome: abdominal pain visual analogue scale (VAS) scores
shoulder pain visual analogue scale (VAS) scores
cohort: Thirty-one patients with American Society of Anesthesiologists scores of 1-3 who underwent elective gynecologic laparoscopic surgery were included.
finding: Patients with higher Abdominal Compliance Index (ACI) levels (≥2.16 L/m2) experienced significantly higher abdominal pain at 30 minutes, higher shoulder pain at 24 and 36 hours postoperatively, and required more analgesics compared to those with lower ACI levels.
